I try and thank everyone who makes a kind comment about the animals. If I have missed some. My apologies. I will get to reading them all. I don’t do that for follows or friendships. I do that because I was raised if someone speaks to you, you speak to them.  My sole purpose here as I have said many times is to share different wolfdog behaviors. So people have a better understanding of them. And will hopefully use their voice to save wolves. That’s it. Period. As I’ve also mentioned many times, yes, they can be trained. None of mine are. I am ok with that. These guys pretty much act like themselves. I don’t spend a lot of time scolding them or correcting them. I correct them when they fence fight. Or if they pick on eachother. Other than that, no. And that’s how it is here. Don’t care how anyone feels about that. I love my animals, and work very hard to keep them happy and healthy. I THANK all of you so much for following and supporting and taking time to learn about these amazing animals. Again, these are Wolfdogs.  ❤️🐺🙏.                                              #keeperofthewolves #savewolves #foryoupage #wolfdogs #packpeculiar
